quotations.old_english: Ðeáh ðe hé líchamlíce on heora slege andwerd nǽre
quotations.english: though he was not present in the body at their slaughter

quotations.old_english: Seó stów ðe Drihten líchomlíce néhst on stód on middangearde

quotations.english: they saw him with their bodily eyes

quotations.old_english: Ðeáh ðe hé lícumlíce æfward wære

source_text: lícham-, lícum-líce; adv. Bodily, in the body :-- Ðeáh ðe hé líchamlíce on heora slege andwerd nǽre though he was not present in the body at their slaughter, Homl. Th. i. 82, 33. Líchamlíce corporaliter, Ælfc. Gr. 38; Sam. 41, 6. Seó stów ðe Drihten líchomlíce néhst on stód on middangearde, Blickl. Homl. 125, 15. Hié hine líchomlíce gesáwon they saw him with their bodily eyes, 135, 19. Ðeáh ðe hé lícumlíce æfward wære quamvis corporaliter absens, Bd. 3, 15; S. 542, 6.
